tool.description: Calculates secondary structure assignments from PDB files using mkdssp (DSSP). DSSP is a standard tool for assigning secondary structure to amino acids in protein structures.

param.name: threads
param.label: Number of Threads
param.help: Number of CPU threads to use

tool.help:
**dssp_mkdssp**
Calculates secondary structure assignments from PDB files using mkdssp (DSSP). DSSP is a standard tool for assigning secondary structure to amino acids in protein structures.
**nf-core Module Information:**
- Module: dssp/mkdssp - Container: biocontainers/dssp:4.5.3
**Usage:** This tool provides the functionality from the nf-core module within Galaxy workflows.
